erosion: Unchanged R14 proposal/contact timing; partial removed mass rounded downward to a quantum before applied transactions; full contacts exact
channel: Unchanged binary64 settling factor; floor outgoing mass to quantum and keep exact deposited complement
origin_remap: Integer proportional transportation matrix with exact row/column margins; each incidence floor or ceiling of represented proportional ideal
migration: Per original origin, positive-constrained allocation across every currently positive retained/exported slot; exact initial total; preserve every positive predecessor incidence and every layer
error_accumulator: Outward-rounded integer quantum-unit L1 bounds, converted using the minimum declared density times solid fraction including deposited packing
justification: A quantum is about 5.42e-20 kg; even billions of unit allocation discrepancies remain below the new 1e-10 m3 cap. The cap is 100000 times tighter than the predecessor hillside allocation cap. A separate 1e-12 m3 migration cap is included in the total. Runtime checks enforce both, without post-failure widening.
error_scope: Additional local applied-transfer/origin approximation relative to each represented proposal; not predecessor trajectory equivalence or a propagated global nonlinear/empirical error bound
